sources.summary: Polish-American architect Daniel Libeskind has been named architecture laureate for this year's Praemium Imperiale awards by the Japan Art Association. Libeskind, who leads the New York-based Studio Libeskind and is one of the judges for this year's Dezeen Awards, was selected for the award for his work creating "emotionally resonant, innovative, and sustainable" architecture.
